features.title: Engine sync mechanism with braga-3d
features.user_visible_behavior: Engine fixes can be ported from braga-3d in one documented step.
verification: scripts/sync-engine.sh reports changes; scripts/engine-base.json records the base
features.notes: Hash-guarded 3-way (base, fork, braga HEAD): --dry-run prints same|behind|ahead|diverged; --apply copies behind files only and writes *.conflict for diverged ones; --record advances the base.

features.title: Session 006 hardening: API defaults, cinema config, SEO, sky lift, safe engine sync
features.user_visible_behavior: Bare /api/adsb and /api/route work; the overview is readable at the default time; crawlers find robots.txt, sitemap.xml, JSON-LD and hreflang; unknown URLs show a branded 404.
verification: headless load: 0 page errors, 0 console warnings
evidence: mean map luma 71.6 -> 89.6 at the default time, 73.2 -> 104.1 at sunset (/tmp/g3d/*.png)
features.notes: At session 006 the sky work was the lighting lift only; clouds and shafts were tuned in session 007 (gui-014). Accepted fit drift is documented in src/fit.js FIT_RULES (castelo, penha, santos-passos, vila-flor).

features.title: Session 007: 360 panoramas, videos, clouds and shafts, adaptive governor
features.user_visible_behavior: Castle and Paco dos Duques open a real 360 video. Fair-weather clouds drift by default and cast moving shadows. Low-sun shafts read more clearly and close under a solid deck or rain. A slow device loses resolution, shadow size, post passes and stream radius in steps, and gets them back.
verification: npm run verify (7/7), npm run check:fit
npm run check:data -- --online: the 2 panoramas pass the projection check; 9 older video entries show title or channel drift (open)
node /tmp/g3d/gov.mjs <url> 8 and 20: level 0 to 3 to 0, 0 console errors or warnings
evidence: panoramas Q8_1XgfAt0o (castelo), iCyaeIHmIR8 (paco-duques): EQUIRECTANGULAR on the watch page
overview 1.81 M triangles at 1920x1080 (budget 2.4 M), 196 calls; clouds add 1 call and 2 triangles
8x CPU throttle: 30 ms at level 0, 23 ms after the governor settled at level 3; 20x: 88 ms to 72 ms; both recover to 16.7 ms
features.notes: Panoramas: 2 of 18. Oliveira, Penha, Santa Marinha, stadium and Briteiros have no verified true-360 video (only flat ones titled 360). The landmark near-LOD step of the governor does not exist here (landmarks.js has only the screen-size far LOD). The 4x throttle did not slow the frame at all on this machine (vsync-bound at 16.7 ms).

features.title: Real-time weather by intensity; live mode on for first visits
features.user_visible_behavior: A slight shower (WMO 80, 61, or under 0.6 mm) draws as light rain, a moderate one as rain, a heavy one (82, 65-67, over 2.5 mm) as a downpour. A first visit with no saved choice opens in live mode with the real badge. An explicit '0', a #weather= or #time= hash, and saved choices still win.
verification: npm run build, npm run verify: OK
headless fresh visit (no localStorage) on a preview build and on production: live mode on, badge 'Guimarães now · 18° · sunset/sunrise · thunderstorm' matches Open-Meteo (code 95, 17.5 C)

each state forced with #weather=<state>&time=noon: clear, partly, overcast, drizzle, rain, downpour, fog; screenshots /tmp/g3d/state-*.png read; streak density and grey rise in that order; console 0 errors, 0 warnings on the preview
evidence: src/weather.js states drizzle (rain 0.28), rain (0.65, now moderate), downpour (1.0, the old rain dials)
src/live.js weatherFromCode and wantLive; cities/guimaraes.json default_live; src/guide.js labels
features.notes: Only the thunderstorm reading was live during the test, so the drizzle, rain and downpour mapping was checked by forcing the states, not by a real shower. Thunder (95+) still maps to rain, as in porto. On production the console shows one 404 for /data/gtfs/schedule.json (no GTFS feed yet; it existed before this change). No new locale strings: 'морось' and 'ливень' already had PT and EN.
